《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：
上海电车公司与其工人。
关于上海电车公司与其工人之间的纠纷，当地党部、公安局官员以及上海公共租界工部局警务处的罗伯逊（Robertson）先生近日前往该公司进行调解。来访者受到总经理的接见。
中方官员表示，鉴于生活成本高昂，工人的要求并非不合理，公司应予满足。
总经理答复称，加薪问题可以同意，但无法接受支付退休金及复职被解雇工人的要求。
官员们承诺在向工人进行调查后处理此点。
工人们将于明天召开公司各部门代表会议，讨论解决纠纷的措施。
《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：
两家双缫丝厂之工人。
为支持福伦双缫丝厂，位于闸北的鸿伦丝厂也已停工。
为了生计并体恤丝厂的困难，工人们自愿做出让步，目前仅要求加薪3分，以便早日复工。
资方将考虑此事。丝厂很可能会接受工人的要求并恢复运营。
《字林西报》（香港电报）：
太古洋行与其海员。
上海的粤籍团体“电新堂”和“美安堂”于7月19日向广州各商行和商人发出如下电报回复：
“在贵方电报中，我方受指示向各港口发布通函电报，宣布断绝与太古洋行轮船的所有业务往来。
“我们已举行联席会议，决议遵从贵方要求。我们担心，如果太古洋行继续拖延解决，存放在仓库中的货物将会受损。会议决议请贵方与海员工会安排，清理太古洋行仓库中的货物。只有在劳资纠纷解决后，才会恢复与太古洋行的业务。”

LABOUR.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE SHANGHAI TRAMWAYS COMPANY AND ITS WORKERS.

About 60 representatives of workers of various departments of the Shanghai Tramways Company attended a conference held yesterday evening by the 3rd District Water-Works & Electricity Trade Workers Union at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a date be fixed for a meeting of the entire body of conductors at which measures for an increase of wages and for the abolition of "squeeze" will be drawn up.
2. That unemployed workers request the supreme organs to open immediate negotiations for their reinstatement.
3. That the crimes of a "labour thief" named Wong Ah-foh be made known to the public.
4. That Messrs. Yuan Lee-tung, Ling Kong-han, Wong Shao-lai, etc. be requested to uphold justice.
5. That substantial support be rendered to the discharged hands of the Shanghai Power Company and that, if necessary, united action be taken.
6. That the General Labour Union be requested to hold a joint conference of labour unions to discuss measures of assistance.
7. That a manifesto and a letter addressed to the people be issued.

（批：D 4176 C）

July 8, 1933.    5.    Morning Translation

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE SHANGHAI TRAMWAYS CO. AND ITS WORKERS.

At a conference held on July 6 by the workers
of the Shanghai Tramways Company, the following demands
were drawn up and will be submitted to the Company:-
1. That one month's pay be issued as retirement
gratuity to a worker with more than 6 months but less
than one year's service; that those who have worked
less than 2 years be given 2 months' pay as retirement
gratuity and other cases in proportion.
2. That all hands dismissed without cause be
reinstated.
3. That the Company grant a monthly increase of
$15 to conductors and drivers; that a monthly increase
of $6 be granted to child workers and to the hands of
the Machinery Department; that a yearly increase of $2
be given hereafter.
4. That a reward of 15 cents be given to workers
who sell tickets to the amount of 7,000 coppers; 25 cents
for the sale of tickets to the amount of 9,000 coppers;
30 cents for the sale of tickets to the amount of over
10,000 coppers.
5. That those workers who have worked for 20 days
be given 22 days' pay and double pay be issued for work
on festivals and holidays.
6. That the Union guarantee that no "squeeze" will
be resorted to by conductors and should any conductor
committing a "squeeze" be discovered, he be dismissed
by the Company without any right as to the privileges
mentioned in No. 1.
According to a responsible person of the
workers, the demands will be submitted to the local Tangpu
and other political organs which will be requested to
open negotiations with the Company.
In the event of the negotiations ending in
failure, effective measures will be adopted and the
dispute may spread.

no truth that the so-called "Manchukuo" delegates

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海电车公司与其工人。

在7月6日举行的上海电车公司工人会议上，制定了以下要求，并将提交给公司：
1. 服务满6个月但不足1年的工人，离职时发给一个月工资作为退休金；服务不满2年的工人，发给两个月工资作为退休金，其他情况按比例计算。
2. 所有无故被解雇的工人予以复职。
3. 公司每月给售票员和司机加薪15元；每月给童工和机器部工人加薪6元；此后每年加薪2元。
4. 售票额达7000铜元的工人奖励1角5分；售票额达9000铜元的奖励2角5分；售票额超过10000铜元的奖励3角。
5. 工作20天的工人发给22天工资，节日和假日工作发给双倍工资。
6. 工会保证售票员不进行“揩油”，如发现任何售票员有“揩油”行为，由公司将其解雇，且无权享受第1条所述的待遇。
据一位工人负责人称，这些要求将提交给当地党部和其他政治机构，并请它们与公司进行谈判。
如果谈判失败，将采取有效措施，纠纷可能会扩大。

唐有壬抵达

中央政治委员会秘书长唐有壬昨晨从南京抵达此地，将于今日或明日因私事前往江苏。
唐先生在昨日接受《申时通讯社》记者采访时提供了以下信息：
中日代表在大连的谈判是非正式的，谈判达成的决定不会签署。所谓“满洲国”代表……（原文中断）

Labour (4)

3rd District Water & Electricity Workers' Union

At 2.30 p.m. September 26, the Bureau of Social
Affairs summoned Chang Hung-fah (龔鴻發) and Ho Chao-ming
(賀兆明), two ex-workers of the Shanghai Power Company
to the Bureau where they were received by Chu Kuei-ling
(朱桂林), an investigator of the Bureau who is
concurrently a reporter of the Sing Sung News Agency,
280 Shantung Road. The two callers alleged that they
had been dismissed by the Company for no reason other
than being responsible for the organization of the
3rd District Water & Electricity Workers' Union and
urged that the Social Bureau adopt effective measures
to secure their reinstatement failing which the workers
would most probably declare a strike. The callers
left at 4 p.m. September 26, after having been informed
that the matter would receive the attention of the Bureau.

1932年9月28日

劳工 (4)

第三区水电工人工会

9月26日下午2时30分，社会局传召上海电力公司两名前雇员龚鸿发（Chang Hung-fah）和贺兆明（Ho Chao-ming）到局，由该局调查员兼山东路280号星声通讯社记者朱桂林（Chu Kuei-ling）接待。两名来访者声称，他们被公司解雇的唯一原因是负责组建第三区水电工人工会，并敦促社会局采取有效措施确保他们复职，否则工人们极有可能宣布罢工。在获知此事将得到社会局关注后，两名来访者于9月26日下午4时离开。

pages.en:
September 26, 1932. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Shun Pao:

OFFICIAL ORGANS TO MEDIATE TRAMWAY WORKERS DISPUTE.

The workers of the Shanghai Tramway Company
in the International Settlement have organized a 3rd District
Waterworks and Electricity Labour Union. Their organization
has been formally inaugurated by the Kuomintang and other
official organs.
Three members of the Standing Committee of
this Union were recently dismissed without cause by the
Tramway Company. The Union then reported the dismissal
to the aforesaid official organs and submitted the
following demands:-
(1) That the dismissed workers be reinstated.
(2) That wages be paid during the period of their dismissal.
The District Kuomintang and the Social
Bureau have detailed representatives to the Company
to investigate the matter.
As they learned that the workers were
dismissed without any reason whatever, the official
organs intend to mediate in the matter to the best of
their authority. The Union was requested yesterday to
send its representatives to the Social Bureau at
2 p.m., September 26 for purpose of interrogation.
pages.zh:
1932年9月26日。晨间译稿。

劳工。

《申报》：

官方机构调解电车工人纠纷。

国际公共租界内的上海电车公司工人已组织起第三区水电工人工会。该组织已由国民党及其他官方机构正式批准成立。
该工会常务委员会的三名成员最近被电车公司无故解雇。工会随后向上述官方机构报告了此次解雇事件，并提出以下要求：
(1) 恢复被解雇工人的职务。
(2) 支付他们在被解雇期间的工资。
区党部和社会局已派遣代表前往该公司调查此事。
由于获悉这些工人是毫无理由地被解雇，官方机构打算在其职权范围内尽力调解此事。工会已于昨日接到通知，要求其代表于9月26日下午2时前往社会局接受问询。

pages.en:
Eastern Times:

THE SHANGHAI TRAMWAY COMPANY DISPUTE.

It will be recalled that the strike was
declared owing to the management having dismissed
three workers, members of the Standing Committee of the
Third District Waterworks and Electricity Labour Union,
which institution has been formally acknowledged by
the local authorities.
At 2 p.m. yesterday, two representatives
of the above-mentioned Labour Union were appointed to
go to the Social Bureau where after being interrogated,
the officials of this latter institution issued several
instructions to be followed out when it is understood,
the strike might soon terminate.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》：

上海电车公司纠纷。

人们记得，此次罢工是因为管理层解雇了第三区水电工人工会常务委员会的三名工人而引发的，该工会已得到地方当局的正式承认。
昨日下午2时，上述工会的两名代表奉命前往社会局，在接受问询后，该局官员发布了几项指示以供遵循，据悉，罢工可能很快结束。

September 26, 2.

Political (3)

3rd District Water & Electricity Workers' Union - Meeting

Between 2.10 and 3 p.m. September 24, five
committee members of the abovementioned union held
a meeting in their office, 12 Tien Shing Li, Sinking
Road, Chapel, when the following resolutions were passed :-

1. That a manifesto be published opposing the recognition
of Manchukuo by Japan.

2. That the National Government be urged to despatch
punitive expeditions to the North East for the
purpose of recovering the lost territory as well as
eliminating the bogus organization.
pages.zh:
9月26日，2。

政治 (3)

第三区水电工人工会 - 会议

9月24日下午2时10分至3时之间，上述工会的五名委员在闸北新疆路天兴里12号的办公室举行会议，通过了以下决议：

1. 发表宣言，反对日本承认满洲国。

2. 敦促国民政府派遣讨伐队前往东北，以收复失地并铲除伪组织。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D H 176
26/9/32

Daily Intelligence September 26
Political (2)

Anti-Japanese Movement

Following the receipt of a letter on September 21,
purporting to emanate from the Blood & Soul Corps for the
Extermination of Traitors demanding that the shops on Nanking
Road be purged of their Japanese goods within five days time
and threatening drastic action against those failing to do
so, the 1st District Citizens' Association, 68 Wu Foh Loong,
Nanking Road, has issued a circular to all member shops on
Nanking Road, quoting this letter and urging them of their own
accord to seal the Japanese goods in their shops.

3rd District Water & Electricity Workers' Union - Meeting

Between 2.10 and 3 p.m. September 24, five committee
members of the abovementioned union held a meeting in their
office, 12 Tien Shing Li, Sinkiang Road, Chapei, when the
following resolutions were passed :-

1. That a manifesto be published opposing the recognition
of Manchukuo by Japan.

2. That the National Government be urged to despatch punitive
expeditions to the North East for the purpose of recovering
the lost territory as well as eliminating the bogus
organization.

政治 (2)

反日运动

9月21日收到一封据称来自“铁血锄奸团”的信件，要求南京路上的商店在五天内清除其店内的日货，并威胁对未照办者采取严厉行动。此后，位于南京路68号五福隆的北区市民协会向南京路所有会员商店发出通告，引用了这封信，并敦促他们主动封存店内的日货。

2. 敦促国民政府派遣讨伐队前往东北，以收复失地并铲除伪组织。

3rd District Water and Electricity Workers' Union - Meeting
The 3rd District (Settlement) Water and Electricity
Workers' Union, 33 Kung Yih Li, Mongolia Road off North
Thibet Road, O.O.L., was removed on September 16 to
12 Tien Shing Li, Singkiang Road, off Haining Road, O.O.L.
Fifteen members of the 3rd District Water and
Electricity Workers' Union held a conference in their
office at 12 Tien Shing Li, Singkiang Road, off Haining
Road, O.O.L. between 3 and 4 p.m. September 18 and
decided to persuade the workers of the Shanghai Power
Company and the Shanghai Water Works to join the Union
in order to unify efforts to fight the capitalists.
pages.zh:
- 摘自1932年9月19日情报报告。
第三区水电工人工会 - 会议
第三区（租界）水电工人工会原址为北西藏路蒙古路公义里33号（越界筑路区），于9月16日迁至海宁路新疆路天兴里12号（越界筑路区）。
9月18日下午3时至4时之间，第三区水电工人工会的十五名成员在海宁路新疆路天兴里12号（越界筑路区）的办公室召开会议，决定劝说上海电力公司和上海自来水公司的工人加入工会，以统一力量对抗资本家。

pages.en:
Shun Pao and other local newspapers: 254
SHANGHAI TRAMWAY COMPANY DISPUTE.
Owing to the dismissal of Wu Chao-ming, Jun Hung-fah,
and Fong Siu-ngai, without just cause, a dispute has arisen
between the workers and the management of the Shanghai Tramway
Company. The 3rd District Water-works Labour Union has
petitioned the Social Bureau to negotiate with the Company
concerned to reinstate the three dismissed men and to pay
them their wages for the period of during which they
absented themselves from work.
The Social Bureau has appointed its inspector
Chu Kwei-lin to examine the matter.

3rd District Water & Electricity Workers' Union - Meeting

The 3rd District (Settlement) Water and Electricity
Workers' Union, 33 Kung Yih Li, Mongolia Road off North
Thibet Road, C.O.L., was removed on September 16 to
12 Tien Shing Li, Singkiang Road, off Haining Road, C.O.L.

Fifteen members of the 3rd District Water and
Electricity Workers' Union held a conference in their
office at 12 Tien Shing Li, Singkiang Road, off Haining
Road, C.O.L. between 3 and 4 p.m. September 18 and
decided to persuade the workers of the Shanghai Power
Company and the Shanghai Water Works to join the Union
in order to unify efforts to fight the capitalists.
pages.zh:
《申报》及其他本地报纸： 254
上海电车公司纠纷。
由于吴兆明（Wu Chao-ming）、龚鸿发（Jun Hung-fah）和冯小艾（Fong Siu-ngai）被无故解雇，上海电车公司的工人与管理层之间发生了纠纷。第三区水电工人工会已向社局请愿，要求与有关公司交涉，恢复这三名被解雇人员的职务，并支付他们缺勤期间的工资。
社会局已指派其视察员朱桂林（Chu Kwei-lin）审查此事。
